Chapter 7

Operators and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs)Operator 与 CRD

Kubernetes comes with a core feature set to fulfill the basic needs for running application stacks with a standard set of primitives. For custom use cases, Kubernetes allows for installing extensions to the platform, operators.

Kubernetes 自带一套核心特性，可以用一组标准原语满足运行应用栈的基本需求。对于定制化场景，Kubernetes 允许向平台安装扩展——也就是 operator（操作员）。

A Custom Resource Definition (CRD) is a Kubernetes extension mechanism (often bundled with an operator) for introducing custom API primitives to fulfill requirements not covered by built-in primitives.

Custom Resource Definition（CRD，自定义资源定义）是一种 Kubernetes 扩展机制（通常与 operator 一起打包），用于引入自定义 API 原语，以满足内置原语无法覆盖的需求。

This chapter will focus on the installation and configuration of operators, as well the interaction with provided CRDs.

本章将聚焦于 operator 的安装与配置，以及如何与所提供的 CRD 交互。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖范围

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objective: Understand CRDs, install and configure operators.

本章对应以下考试大纲要点：理解 CRD，安装并配置 operator。

Working with Operators使用 Operator

Operators extend the core behavior of the Kubernetes cluster without actually changing the Kubernetes code. You can think of the operator as a plug-in to the platform. Operators typically automate tasks that would have to be performed by humans, such as deploying, configuring, scaling, upgrading, and managing applications.

Operator 无需真正修改 Kubernetes 代码即可扩展集群的核心行为。你可以把它理解为平台的插件。Operator 通常把原本需要人工完成的任务自动化，例如部署、配置、扩缩容、升级以及管理应用。

— PDF p.101 —

The Operator PatternOperator 模式

An operator usually consists of multiple components: one or more CRDs, a controller, and often additional components like RBAC rules for permissions. CRDs can be understood as the schema that defines the blueprint for a custom object, and the instantiation of those objects with the newly introduced type, also called the Custom Resources (CR).

一个 operator 通常由多个组件构成：一个或多个 CRD、一个控制器（controller），以及诸如 RBAC 权限规则之类的附加组件。CRD 可以理解为定义自定义对象蓝图的 schema；而用这种新引入类型实例化出来的对象，称为自定义资源（Custom Resource，CR）。

For a CRD to be useful, it has to be backed by a controller. Controllers interact with the Kubernetes API and implement the reconciliation logic that interacts with CRD objects.

CRD 要发挥作用，必须有控制器作为后端。控制器与 Kubernetes API 交互，并实现与 CRD 对象打交道的调和（reconciliation）逻辑。

The combination of CRDs and controllers is commonly referred to as the operator pattern. The exam does not require you to have an understanding of controllers; therefore, their implementation won’t be covered in this chapter. Figure 7-1 shows the operator pattern with all its moving parts.

CRD 与控制器的组合通常称为 operator 模式。考试不要求你理解控制器的实现，因此本章不展开。图 7-1 展示了 operator 模式及其全部组成部件。

Discovering Operators发现 Operator

The Kubernetes community has implemented many useful operators discoverable on OperatorHub.io or Artifact Hub.

Kubernetes 社区已经实现了许多有用的 operator，可以在 OperatorHub.io 或 Artifact Hub 上检索到。

A prominent operator is the External Secrets Operator that helps with integrating external Secret managers, like Amazon Web Services (AWS) Secrets Manager and HashiCorp Vault, with Kubernetes. Another is the Crossplane operator, which helps with creating and managing cloud resources using declarative syntax.

一个著名的 operator 是 External Secrets Operator，它帮助把外部 Secret 管理器（如 AWS Secrets Manager 和 HashiCorp Vault）与 Kubernetes 集成。另一个是 Crossplane operator，它用声明式语法创建和管理云资源。

— PDF p.102 —

To demonstrate the functionality of OperatorHub.io, we are going to search and install the popular Argo CD Operator, a declarative GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes that automates deployments by continuously monitoring applications and synchronizing them with the desired state defined in Git repositories.

为演示 OperatorHub.io 的功能，我们将搜索并安装流行的 Argo CD Operator——它是面向 Kubernetes 的声明式 GitOps 持续交付工具，通过持续监控应用并将其与 Git 仓库中定义的期望状态同步来自动化部署。

In your browser, open the URL for OperatorHub.io and enter the term argo cd into the search box named Search OperatorHub. You will receive a result, shown in Figure 7-2.

在浏览器中打开 OperatorHub.io 的网址，在名为 Search OperatorHub 的搜索框中输入 argo cd。你会看到如图 7-2 所示的结果。

Clicking on the Argo CD panel will bring you to the details of the Argo CD Operator, shown in Figure 7-3.

点击 Argo CD 面板会进入 Argo CD Operator 的详情页，如图 7-3 所示。

The page describes the functionality of the operator including a high-level overview on the provided CRDs. To be able to create CRs from the CRDs, we’ll first need to install the operator.

该页面描述了 operator 的功能，包括所提供 CRD 的高层概览。要想用 CRD 创建 CR，我们需要先安装 operator。

— PDF p.103 —

Installing Operators安装 Operator

You can install many of those operators with a single kubectl command execution or by using the Helm executable. For more information on using Helm, see Chapter 8.

你可以用一条 kubectl 命令或使用 Helm 可执行文件来安装其中许多 operator。关于使用 Helm 的更多信息，参见第 8 章。

Clicking the Install button on OperatorHub.io brings up the installation instructions, as shown in Figure 7-4.

在 OperatorHub.io 上点击 Install 按钮会弹出安装说明，如图 7-4 所示。

As shown on the installation page for the operator, we’ll use the Operator Lifecycle Manager (OLM), a tool to help manage the operators running on your cluster. This is a one-time operation:

正如该 operator 安装页所示，我们将使用 Operator Lifecycle Manager（OLM）——一个帮助管理集群上所运行 operator 的工具。这是一次性操作：

$ curl -sL https://github.com/operator-framework/operator-lifecycle-manager/\
releases/download/v0.31.0/install.sh | bash -s v0.31.0

Next, we’ll install the Argo CD Operator, which will place the operator objects into the operators namespace:

接下来安装 Argo CD Operator，它会把 operator 对象放入 operators 命名空间：

$ kubectl create -f https://operatorhub.io/install/argocd-operator.yaml
subscription.operators.coreos.com/my-argocd-operator created
— PDF p.104 —

You can follow the installation process by running the following command. A valid installation finishes with the Succeeded phase in the rendered output of the command:

你可以运行以下命令跟踪安装过程。成功安装后，命令输出中的 phase 会显示为 Succeeded：

$ kubectl get csv -n operators
NAME                      DISPLAY   VERSION   REPLACES                  PHASE
argocd-operator.v0.13.0   Argo CD   0.13.0    argocd-operator.v0.12.0   Succeeded

You are now ready to use the operator. Please refer to the next sections in the chapter to interact with the installed CRDs.

现在你已经可以使用该 operator。请参阅本章后续小节，与已安装的 CRD 交互。

Working with Custom Resource Definitions使用自定义资源定义

For the exam, you will need to understand how to discover CRD schemas provided by external operators and how to interact with objects that follow the CRD schema.

考试中，你需要理解如何发现外部 operator 提供的 CRD schema，以及如何与遵循该 schema 的对象交互。

Discovering CRDs发现 CRD

The Argo CD Operator provides a couple of CRDs like Application, ApplicationSet, AppProject, and some more. The high-level purpose of each is as follows:

Argo CD Operator 提供了若干 CRD，例如 Application、ApplicationSet、AppProject 等。它们的高层用途如下：

  • Application: An Application is a group of Kubernetes resources as defined by a manifest.Application：一个 Application 就是由一份 manifest 定义的一组 Kubernetes 资源。
  • ApplicationSet: An ApplicationSet is a group or set of Application resources.ApplicationSet：一个 ApplicationSet 是一组 Application 资源的集合。
  • AppProject: An AppProject is a logical grouping that defines which Git repositories, clusters, and namespaces a set of Applications can access, providing multi-tenancy and security boundaries within ArgoCD.AppProject：AppProject 是一种逻辑分组，定义一组 Application 可以访问哪些 Git 仓库、集群和命名空间，从而在 ArgoCD 内部提供多租户和安全边界。
— PDF p.105 —

Run the following command to list all installed CRDs. You will find the Argo CD CRDs in the command output:

运行以下命令列出所有已安装的 CRD。你会在输出中找到 Argo CD 的 CRD：

$ kubectl get crds
NAME                                          CREATED AT
applications.argoproj.io                      2025-03-21T23:02:40Z
applicationsets.argoproj.io                   2025-03-21T23:02:39Z
appprojects.argoproj.io                       2025-03-21T23:02:39Z
argocdexports.argoproj.io                     2025-03-21T23:02:39Z
argocds.argoproj.io                           2025-03-21T23:02:39Z
notificationsconfigurations.argoproj.io       2025-03-21T23:02:39Z

As with any other Kubernetes object, you can render the details. The details of the CRD will reveal the kind, API group and version, and its properties. This command inspects the Application CRD:

与其他 Kubernetes 对象一样，你可以渲染详情。CRD 的详情会显示其 kind、API 组与版本以及属性。下面这条命令检查 Application CRD：

$ kubectl describe crd applications.argoproj.io

For brevity, I do not show the lengthy output. In the next section, we are going to create a CR for the Application CRD.

为简洁起见，这里不展示冗长输出。下一节我们将为 Application CRD 创建一个 CR。

Instantiating a CR for one of the CRDs为某个 CRD 实例化 CR

The Application CRD describes a schema for defining an application representation that lives in a Git repository so that it can be deployed to a Kubernetes cluster. For that purpose, create a new YAML manifest of kind Application in the file nginx-application.yaml, as shown in Example 7-1. You may recognize some of the properties used when you rendered the CRD schema.

Application CRD 描述了一种 schema，用于定义存放在 Git 仓库中的应用表示，以便将其部署到 Kubernetes 集群。为此，在 nginx-application.yaml 文件中新建一份 kind 为 Application 的 YAML manifest，如示例 7-1 所示。你会认出渲染 CRD schema 时见过的一些属性。

Example 7-1. Instantiation of CR for the Application CRD

示例 7-1. 为 Application CRD 实例化 CR

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: nginx
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/bmuschko/cka-study-guide.git
    targetRevision: HEAD
    path: ./ch07/nginx
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: default
— PDF p.106 —

Create a new object from the YAML manifest:

用这份 YAML manifest 创建一个新对象：

kubectl apply -f nginx-application.yaml
application.argoproj.io/nginx created

Interacting with a CR与 CR 交互

You can interact with the CR like any other object in Kubernetes. All kubectl create, read, update, and delete (CRUD) functions are available. For example, to list the object, use the describe command. The following command shows the operations in action:

你可以像对待 Kubernetes 中任何其他对象一样与 CR 交互。所有 kubectl 的创建、读取、更新、删除（CRUD）功能都可用。例如，要查看对象详情，使用 describe 命令。下面这条命令展示了实际操作：

$ kubectl describe application nginx
Name:         nginx
Namespace:    default
Labels:       <none>
Annotations:  <none>
API Version:  argoproj.io/v1alpha1
Kind:         Application
...

To delete the object, use the delete command, as shown here:

要删除对象，使用 delete 命令，如下所示：

$ kubectl delete application nginx
application.argoproj.io "nginx" deleted

We demonstrated that an operator can install CRDs into the cluster, and that we can create CR from the CRDs and interact with them.

我们已经演示了：operator 可以把 CRD 安装到集群中；我们可以基于 CRD 创建 CR 并与之交互。

Going deeper using Argo CD would require a chapter on its own and is beyond the coverage of the certification. For more information on Argo CD, check out the book Argo CD: Up and Running by Andrew Block and Christian Hernandez (O’Reilly, 2025).

深入讲解 Argo CD 需要单独一章，超出了认证范围。关于 Argo CD 的更多信息，可参阅 Andrew Block 和 Christian Hernandez 所著的《Argo CD: Up and Running》（O’Reilly，2025）。

Inspecting the Controller检查控制器

The Argo CD CRs just represent data and won’t be useful by themselves. A controller acts as a reconciliation process by inspecting the state of CR objects via calls to the Kubernetes API to perform a deployment process to the cluster.

Argo CD 的 CR 只是数据表示，本身没有用处。控制器充当调和进程：通过调用 Kubernetes API 检查 CR 对象的状态，并对集群执行部署流程。

The Argo CD Operator runs the controller logic within a Pod managed by a Deployment. You can discover the Argo CD controller objects as follows:

Argo CD Operator 把控制器逻辑运行在一个由 Deployment 管理的 Pod 中。你可以按如下方式发现 Argo CD 控制器对象：

$ kubectl get deployments,pods -n operators
NAME                                                 READY   UP-TO-DATE   ...
deployment.apps/argocd-operator-controller-manager   1/1     1            ...
NAME                                                      READY   STATUS    ...
pod/argocd-operator-controller-manager-6998544bff-zx8bg   1/1     Running   ...
— PDF p.107 —

Because we installed the operator using OLM, the controller Pod would be placed into the operators namespace to keep them separate from other objects in the cluster. You can scale the number of replicas as needed by changing the configuration of the Deployment.

由于我们使用 OLM 安装 operator，控制器 Pod 会被放入 operators 命名空间，使其与集群中其他对象隔离。你可以通过修改 Deployment 的配置按需调整副本数。

Summary本章小结

Kubernetes refers to the CRD and the corresponding controller as the operator pattern. The Kubernetes community has implemented many operators to fulfill custom requirements. You can install them into your cluster to reuse the functionality.

Kubernetes 把 CRD 及其对应的控制器合称为 operator 模式。Kubernetes 社区已经实现了许多 operator 以满足定制需求。你可以把它们安装到自己的集群中以复用这些功能。

A CRD schema defines the structure of a custom resource. The schema includes the group, name, version, and its configurable attributes. New objects of this kind, CRs, can be created after registering the schema. You can interact with a custom object using kubectl with the same CRUD commands used by any other primitive.

CRD schema 定义了自定义资源的结构，包括组、名称、版本以及可配置属性。注册 schema 之后，就可以创建这种新类型的对象（即 CR）。你可以用 kubectl 以与其他原语相同的 CRUD 命令来与自定义对象交互。

CRDs realize their full potential when combined with a controller implementation. The controller implementation inspects the state of specific custom objects and reacts based on their discovered state.

CRD 与控制器实现结合时才能发挥全部潜力。控制器会检查特定自定义对象的状态，并根据发现的状态做出反应。

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Know how to install operators: Operators built and managed by the Kubernetes community are available on searchable sites like Artifact Hub and OperatorHub.io. You will find installation instructions on the corresponding web pages. You do not have to memorize them for the exam. If you want to explore further, install an open source operator, such as the Prometheus Operator or the Jaeger Operator.掌握安装 operator 的方法：由 Kubernetes 社区构建和维护的 operator 可在 Artifact Hub、OperatorHub.io 等可搜索站点上找到。相应网页上会给出安装说明。考试时不必背下来。如果想进一步探索，可以安装一个开源 operator，例如 Prometheus Operator 或 Jaeger Operator。
  • Acquire a high-level understanding of configurable options for a CRD schema: You are not expected to implement a custom CRD schema. All you need to know is how to discover and interact with them using kubectl. Practice the definition of a CR in the form of a YAML manifest, and create the objects for it. Controller implementations are definitely outside the scope of the exam.从高层理解 CRD schema 的可配置选项：考试不要求你实现自定义 CRD schema。你只需知道如何用 kubectl 发现并与它们交互。练习以 YAML manifest 形式定义 CR 并创建对应对象。控制器的实现绝对不在考试范围内。
— PDF p.108 —

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的参考答案见附录 A。

  1. You decide to manage a MongoDB installation in Kubernetes with the help of the official community operator. This operator provides a CRD. After installing the operator, you will interact with the CRD. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch07/mongodb-operator of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Install the operator using the following command: kubectl apply -f mongodbcommunity.mongodb.com_mongodbcommunity.yaml. List all CRDs using the appropriate kubectl command. Can you identify the CRD that was installed by the installation procedure? Inspect the schema of the CRD. What are the type and property names of this CRD?你决定借助官方社区 operator 在 Kubernetes 中管理一套 MongoDB。该 operator 提供了一个 CRD。安装 operator 后，你要与该 CRD 交互。进入已 clone 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 的 app-a/ch07/mongodb-operator 目录。用以下命令安装 operator：kubectl apply -f mongodbcommunity.mongodb.com_mongodbcommunity.yaml。用合适的 kubectl 命令列出所有 CRD。你能识别出安装过程所安装的那个 CRD 吗？检查该 CRD 的 schema。它的类型和属性名是什么？
  2. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch07/backup-crd of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Create the CRD from the file backup-resource.yaml. Retrieve the details for the Backup custom resource created in the previous step. Create a CR named nginx-backup for the CRD in the default namespace. Provide the following property values: cronExpression: 0 0 * * *; podName: nginx; path: /usr/local/nginx. Retrieve the details for the nginx-backup object created in the previous step.进入已 clone 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 的 app-a/ch07/backup-crd 目录。从文件 backup-resource.yaml 创建 CRD。检索上一步所创建的 Backup 自定义资源的详情。在 default 命名空间中为该 CRD 创建一个名为 nginx-backup 的 CR。提供以下属性值：cronExpression: 0 0 * * *；podName: nginx；path: /usr/local/nginx。检索上一步所创建的 nginx-backup 对象的详情。
